newsitem.title: USA: Cityscape Financial restates Q2, Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Cityscape Financial restates Q2, Q3 results.

text.p: Cityscape Financial Corp said on Tuesday it revised its previously issued statements for its second and third quarter to reflect certain additional changes in the accounting treatment used in acquisitions of Heritable Finance Group and J&J Securities Ltd.

The accounting changes result in the reclassification to goodwill of $5 million of restructuring charges expensed and $17.3 million in deferred tax assets recorded in the 1996 second quarter, leading to an increase in the amount of goodwill recorded in connection with the acquisitions to $30.6 million from $10.6 million.

As a result of these adjustments, the company said second quarter net earnings increased by $2.8 million, or $0.08 per fully diluted share, from $8.3 million, or $0.27 per fully diluted share, to $11.1 million, or $0.35 per fully diluted share.

The increase in goodwill amortization recorded during the third quarter led to a decrease in net income of $502,150, or $0.02 per fully diluted share, to $14.4 million, or $0.43 per fully diluted share, from the previously reported $14.9 million, or $0.45 per fully diluted share.

For the nine months ended September 30, 1996, net income increased $2.3 million to $34.8 million or $1.11 per fully diluted share from the previously announced results of $32.5 million, or $1.04 per fully diluted share.

The company said it will record a $502,150 per quarter increase in amortization expense through the first quarter of 2006. The company said the adjustments relate only to these two acquisitions and not to the core operations.
